title: [master] Description Field value gets automatically reverted the original value after changing it.
summary: Fixed a bug where the Description field on sales lines would revert to its original item value after editing, when Calc. Inv. Discount was enabled and Quantity had been validated.
key_points: Description field was being overwritten by a database reload after Quantity validation
The NeedRefreshSalesLine flag was incorrectly set to false after an early-exit, preventing proper cleanup
Moved the flag reset before the early-exit to ensure RefreshSalesLine doesn't reload uncommitted edits
Bug occurred in CalculateSalesSubPageTotals when totals were already up-to-date
Added test coverage to document the fix
quote: Description Field value gets automatically reverted the original value after changing it.
